title: Minterm representation of a Boolean function
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Form a disjunctive normal form with one minterm for each input $x$ such that $f(x)=-1$, where that minterm is satisfied exactly at $x$ and the value $-1$ represents satisfaction. The Boolean function represented by this formula equals $f$ at every input.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$
